title: Servicemember Residence Protection Act
committees: S-Veterans' Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-09-16 || H-Veterans' Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-03-25 -> Discharged 2025-07-23 -> Markup By 2025-07-23 -> Markup By 2025-07-23 -> Reported By 2025-09-09 [Economic Opportunity Subcommittee: Referred 2025-06-11]
committee_votes: Veterans' Affairs Committee 2025-07-23: Ordered reported - Voice vote
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
summary: This bill amends the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act to preempt state laws that establish squatter’s rights for premises owned by a servicemember in situations where the premises is occupied by a squatter during a period of military service of the servicemember.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
